reason: Authoritative 2026-05-14 state of OpenAI Realtime API. Implementer MUST use these exact model IDs (gpt-realtime-2, gpt-realtime-translate), endpoints (/v1/realtime/client_secrets, /v1/realtime/calls), event names, voice names (marin/cedar), and the @openai/agents-realtime SDK. Prior training data is stale — deprecated gpt-4o-realtime-preview* IDs will be silently broken.

Authoritative 2026-05-14 state of Gemini Live API. Implementer MUST use bidiGenerateContent WebSocket endpoint with `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview`, handle the setup→setupComplete handshake, send audio as `realtimeInput.mediaChunks`, parse `serverContent.{modelTurn,inputTranscription,outputTranscription,turnComplete,interrupted}` and `toolCall`/`toolResponse`. Browser must downsample mic to 16 kHz. API key is exposed to the browser; document this trade-off.

Project-wide reuse principles. Demo intentionally shares one translation atom across overlay + /translator and one provider-agnostic useRealtimeSession hook across both OpenAI and Gemini — guide ensures we don't accidentally split that.
Frontend/backend cohesion. Route Handlers (openai-token, gemini-token, translate, gate proxy) must align with their frontend consumers — guide informs the contract design.
